brief:
Israeli forces fired live ammunition at a Palestinian man's car during a raid on Beit Ula, a town west of Hebron in the occupied West Bank, injuring him, according to Wafa news agency. The incident occurred as troops stormed the area.

Two Palestinians were detained during the operation, though further details about the circumstances of their arrest were not immediately available.
dek: Palestinian man injured in Israeli gunfire, two detained in West Bank A young Palestinian man was injured after Israeli forces stormed the town of Beit Ula, west of Hebron in the occupied West Bank, and fired live ammunition at his car, Wafa reported.
title: Israeli forces shoot Palestinian man in West Bank town
